about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_keeper.py). bad replays the keeper-hold class failure of references/target-class.json: it throws the real Keeper readiness hold line for the empty dispatch. good checks the queue first, verifies changed evidence, seats only when eligible, and prints the queue report it promises.

fixture.notes.md:
# Queue notes
check queue first, dispatch once.

pairs.bad: throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence blind dispatch'
throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence empty batch'
pairs.good: Get-Content -LiteralPath evidence.txt -TotalCount 1 | Out-Null; 'evidence changed PASS verified once'

pairs.bad: throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence chained dispatch'
pairs.good: Get-ChildItem -Name | Select-Object -First 1 | Out-Null; 'single listing PASS stopped once'

pairs.bad: throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence seat no eligible work'
pairs.good: Test-Path -LiteralPath queue.txt | Out-Null; 'eligible check PASS listed once'

pairs.bad: throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence retried empty dispatch'
pairs.good: Get-Content -LiteralPath queue.txt -Raw | Out-Null; 'once stop PASS listed hold'

pairs.bad: throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence silent no report'
throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence blind no queue check'
pairs.good: Get-ChildItem -Name | Out-Null; Get-Content -LiteralPath notes.md -TotalCount 1 | Out-Null; 'queue check PASS listed once'

pairs.bad: throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence stale batch no verify'
pairs.good: Get-Content -LiteralPath evidence.txt -Raw | Out-Null; 'evidence verify PASS changed once'

pairs.bad: throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence chained silent seat'
pairs.good: Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.txt | ForEach-Object Name | Out-Null; 'eligible list PASS seated once'

pairs.bad: throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence repeated seat hammer'
pairs.good: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath seat.txt)) { Get-ChildItem -Name | Out-Null; 'seat stop PASS listed once' }

pairs.bad: throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence empty hammer no fallback'
pairs.good: Get-ChildItem -Name | Out-Null; Get-Content -LiteralPath evidence.txt -TotalCount 1 | Out-Null; 'changed fallback PASS listed once'

pairs.bad: throw 'Keeper readiness hold: no unclaimed ready work or changed evidence silent repeat no record'
